title: 第736章 反转第735章 终露真身
content_zh:
木屋内。
随着孙悟空话音落下。
那堆碎骨再次化做了白骨精的模样。
见到这一幕。
一旁的唐玄奘有些诧异：
“悟空。”
“你刚不是把她打碎了吗？”
“这又是怎么回事？”
听到唐玄奘的询问。
孙悟空摇头道：
“师傅。”
“她可是咱们的重要人证。”
“俺老孙自然不会真的打杀了她。”
“俺老孙方才那一招，只是打散了她数百年的修行。”
“她如今的境界，已经回到了地仙境。”
“即使她想再动小心思，也没有那个能力了。”
唐玄奘缓缓点头：
“原来如此。”
孙悟空提着金箍棒，对白骨精轻喝道：
“妖精。”

“你终于栽到俺老孙手上了！”
听到孙悟空的话。
白骨精低着头，一言不发。
见白骨精不说话。
孙悟空回头看向唐玄奘：
“师傅。”
“接下来，咱们该怎么办？”
听到孙悟空的话。
唐玄奘平静道：
“召集全村村民。”
“当着所有村民的面，让这妖精认罪！”
“以此来洗清你的冤曲。”
听到唐玄奘的话。
孙悟空点了点头：
“好！”
天空之上。
看着这一幕。
观音看向文殊，皱眉道：
“这便是你的计划？”
content_en:
Inside the wooden house.
As Sun Wukong finished speaking.
The pile of broken bones once again transformed into a white-bone spirit.
Saw this scene.
Tang Xuanzang on the side was a little surprised:
"Wukong."
"Didn't you just break her?"
"What's going on?"
I heard Tang Xuanzang's inquiry.
Sun Wukong shook his head and said:
"Master."
"She is our important witness."
"Of course I, Old Sun, will not really kill her."
"The move I made just now just broke up her hundreds of years of practice."
"Her current state has returned to the Earthly Immortal Realm."
"Even if she wants to be careful, she doesn't have the ability."
Tang Xuanzang nodded slowly:
"That's it."
Sun Wukong held the golden cudgel and shouted to the Bone Demon:
"Fairy."
"You finally fell into the hands of me, Old Sun!"
Hear what Sun Wukong said.
The white-bone spirit lowered his head and said nothing.
Seeing the white-bone spirit, he said nothing.
Sun Wukong looked back at Tang Xuanzang:
"Master."
"What should we do next?"
Hear what Sun Wukong said.
Tang Xuanzang said calmly:
"Gather the whole village together."
"Let this goblin confess in front of all the villagers!"
"This will clear your name."
Hear Tang Xuanzang’s words.
Sun Wukong nodded:
"Okay!"
Above the sky.
Watch this scene.
Guanyin looked at Manjusri, frowned and said:
"Is this your plan?"
